config.title: Cal.diy booking subsystem — CodeGraph baseline
config.scope: Web booking subsystem: public booking and management UI, web HTTP/tRPC booking and slot APIs, availability, booking lifecycle, persistence adapters, and supporting notification/calendar services. API v2, generic UI/auth utilities and provider-specific app-store implementations are outside this boundary. Supporting packages include their indexed files, not just booking-exclusive code.

component_rules.label: Public booking routes
component_rules.summary: Public booking, success, booking detail, and reschedule route adapters and server-side loading.

component_rules.label: Booking screens and dashboard
component_rules.summary: Booking views, management components and client helpers not assigned to more specific UI components.

component_rules.label: Booker composition
component_rules.summary: Coordinates the public booking interface and its web wrapper.

component_rules.label: Booking form
component_rules.summary: Attendee booking fields, form and modal presentation.

component_rules.label: Date and time selection
component_rules.summary: Date picker and available-time presentation.

component_rules.label: Booker state and hooks
component_rules.summary: Shared booking state, reservation identifiers, client hooks and form input mapping.

component_rules.label: Availability client queries
component_rules.summary: Client hooks for event details, schedules and slot reservations.

component_rules.label: Booking HTTP endpoints
component_rules.summary: Web endpoints for regular/recurring booking creation and cancellation.

component_rules.label: Booking management RPC
component_rules.summary: Authenticated booking queries and management mutations.

component_rules.label: Availability and slot RPC
component_rules.summary: Schedule lookup, slot availability and temporary reservation procedures.

component_rules.label: Public event RPC
component_rules.summary: Public viewer procedures supporting the booking interface.

component_rules.label: Shared booking domain
component_rules.summary: Booking schemas, policies, dependency wiring and shared helpers outside specialized components.

component_rules.label: Booking creation
component_rules.summary: Regular and recurring booking orchestration, validation and creation helpers.

component_rules.label: Booking cancellation
component_rules.summary: Cancellation orchestration and its supporting types.

component_rules.label: Booking confirmation
component_rules.summary: Pending booking requests and host confirmation handling.

component_rules.label: Rescheduling policy
component_rules.summary: Reschedule prevention and minimum-notice checks; creation also handles rescheduled bookings.

component_rules.label: Seated bookings
component_rules.summary: Seat creation, cancellation and attendee/organizer rescheduling.

component_rules.label: Booking access and attendees
component_rules.summary: Booking access, detail, attendee and assignment services.

component_rules.label: Booking payments
component_rules.summary: Booking payment handling, cancellation refunds and no-show fees.

component_rules.label: Availability computation
component_rules.summary: User and aggregated availability, fixed/round-robin host constraints and schedule selection.

component_rules.label: Busy-time aggregation
component_rules.summary: Busy-period queries and booking-limit constraints.

component_rules.label: Event type services
component_rules.summary: Event type lookup, repositories and configuration used by booking flows.

component_rules.label: Meeting orchestration
component_rules.summary: Coordinates provider-side meeting events during booking lifecycle operations.

component_rules.label: Calendar integration services
component_rules.summary: Calendar operations and integration coordination; provider adapters remain outside the scope.

component_rules.label: Booking notification jobs
component_rules.summary: Booking-specific email/SMS handling and background notification tasks.

component_rules.label: Email delivery and templates
component_rules.summary: Shared email delivery and template package used by booking notifications.

component_rules.label: SMS delivery
component_rules.summary: Shared SMS delivery helpers used by notification flows.

component_rules.label: Booking webhook dispatch
component_rules.summary: Webhook dispatch infrastructure and the booking-trigger bridge.

component_rules.label: Booking event handlers
component_rules.summary: Booking domain event handling and subscription coordination.

component_rules.label: Booking repositories
component_rules.summary: Booking, attendee, seat, payment and tracking repository adapters.

component_rules.label: Database client and adapters
component_rules.summary: Indexed Prisma package helpers; Prisma schema model definitions are not extracted by CodeGraph.

component_rules.label: Booking audit
component_rules.summary: Booking audit services, event records and persistence support.

limitations: Manually configured source-path boundaries; not a semantic ground truth.
Only CodeGraph-indexed files and resolved relationships are represented.
Unindexed assets, Prisma models, dynamic calls and external services may be missing.
Tests are excluded. Missing confidence is retained and counted, not assumed certain.
Lean graph prunes weak links; use full graph for completeness-sensitive scoring.
